iconicTaxa.label: Iconic Taxa
iconicTaxa.description: Recommended: Set this to match your project's taxonomic group. Without it, results may include unrelated observations from other taxa

perPage.label: Results Per Page
perPage.description: Number of observations to display per page

qualityGrade.label: Quality Grade
qualityGrade.description: Filter by quality grade: 'research' = community-verified ID with location and date; 'needs_id' = awaiting community agreement; 'casual' = missing location, date, or flagged as not wild

columnsMobile.label: Columns (Mobile)
columnsMobile.description: Number of columns on mobile screens. 'auto' fills as many columns as the container width allows

columnsDesktop.label: Columns (Desktop)
columnsDesktop.description: Number of columns on desktop screens. 'auto' fills as many columns as the container width allows

showImageCount.label: Show Image Count
showImageCount.description: Display a badge showing the number of additional photos available for each observation
